title: Ilizwi Lokuchasa
intro: Kudala ngaphambi kokuba umntu wokuqala ahambe emhlabeni, isidalwa esinamandla amakhulu sasimi kwindawo yoxolo olupheleleyo, sijikelezwe yimiphefumlo ezinikele kakhulu. Xa kunikwa umyalelo omnye, lonke ilizwi lalithoba ngokuzithoba—kodwa ilizwi elinye laliphakama ngokuchasa, kwaye olo vukelo lwaluza kuvakala kuyo yonke iminyaka kude kube yiMini yokugqibela. Ngubani lo mntu uwileyo?
clues: Ndadalwa ngento eyayivutha kakhulu, ngoxa abanye ecaleni kwam benziwe ngento ababehamba kuyo.
Ndahlala kwindawo engcwele phakathi kwezidalwa ezizinikeleyo, de kwabakho umyalelo omnye owaguqula yonke into.
Xa umyalelo ufika, wonke umphefumlo waqubuda ngaphandle kwam; ukwala kwam kwazalwa likratshi.
Ndagxothwa kuloo ndawo ingcwele, ndaphawulwa ngesiqalekiso esasiya kuhlala ngonaphakade.
Ndacela ixesha kude kube yiMini yoVuko, kwaye lavunywa. Ndafunga ukuba ndiza kusondela kuyo yonke imiphefumlo ndize ndibalahlekise.
Xa ixilongo livakala, abo bandilandelayo baya kuba nesabelo kum, bekunye nam emlilweni ovuthayo apho kungekho mncedi unokubasindisa.

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
